name: Activation Service
definition: Specifies the attributes for an activation.

DedicatedActivation.name: Dedicated Activation
DedicatedActivation.definition: Unique, one-time code that a creditor may require from a debtor for activation purposes, and which is known only by the creditor and the debtor.

EndDate.name: End Date
EndDate.definition: Date and time at which the debtor activation will be deactivated.

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: Date and time at which the debtor activation will be activated.

OriginalActivation.name: Original Activation
OriginalActivation.definition: Specifies the attributes of the original activation.

RelatedActivation.name: Related Activation
RelatedActivation.definition: Specifies the attributes of the activation.

RelatedElectronicInvoiceProcessingServic.name: Related Electronic Invoice Processing Service
RelatedElectronicInvoiceProcessingServic.definition: Related creditor's EIPP provider address to which the debtor activation has to be delivered.
